# Components

116 components in 16 categories. Each page lists its fields, variants, settings, responsive behavior and compatibility.


## commerce

| Component | Level | Variants | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Cart Items](commerce/cart-items.md) | section | default, large, tinted | The products in a customer's cart or order, repeated from Klaviyo event data with a for loop, each row with image, title, quantity and price. |
| [Price](commerce/price.md) | content | default, centered, large | A price, or an original price struck through beside a sale price with an optional discount label. |
| [Product Card](commerce/product-card.md) | content | default, minimal, luxury, editorial, playful | One product: image, badge, name, description, price with sale price and discount, and a button. Five visual variants. |
| [Product Carousel](commerce/product-carousel.md) | section | default, wide, cards | A static, email-safe stand-in for a carousel: a compact row of products with a view-all button. Not interactive, because email clients do not run JavaScript. |
| [Product Grid](commerce/product-grid.md) | section | default, one-column, three-column, four-column, minimal, editorial, luxury, playful | Products in a responsive grid of 1 to 4 columns with an optional heading and a view-all button. Card style is configurable. |
| [Product Showcase](commerce/product-showcase.md) | section | default, reverse, tinted | One product shown large, with highlights, price, a button and an optional gallery row. |

## email

| Component | Level | Variants | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Desktop-only Content](email/desktop-only.md) | section | default | Sections that are hidden on phones. Shown in clients that ignore media queries. |

| [Footer](email/footer.md) | section | default, rich, minimal | Compliance footer: brand name, postal address, unsubscribe and manage-preferences links, plus optional logo, description, social links, navigation, legal links, copyright and disclaimer. |
| [Header](email/header.md) | section | default, left, tinted | Logo bar at the top of an email, using the brand logo (and dark-mode logo when defined), with optional navigation links. |
| [Legal Disclaimer](email/legal-disclaimer.md) | content | default, terms, left | Small print: offer terms, price disclaimers or regulatory text. |
| [Mobile-only Content](email/mobile-only.md) | section | default | Sections that only show on phones. Hidden in clients that ignore media queries. |
| [Outlook-safe Background](email/outlook-safe-background.md) | section | default, tinted | A section with a background photo and a VML fallback so it also shows in Outlook desktop. |
| [Outlook-safe Button](email/outlook-safe-button.md) | content | default, wide, pill | A fixed-size call-to-action button with true rounded corners in Outlook desktop, drawn with VML. |
| [Preference Center](email/preference-center.md) | content | default, left | A "Manage your preferences" link using Klaviyo's manage_preferences_link tag. |
| [Preheader](email/preheader.md) | section | default, unpadded | Hidden inbox preview text, padded so the email body does not leak into it. With no text it uses the preview text set in Klaviyo. |
| [Tracking-safe CTA](email/tracking-safe-cta.md) | content | default, outline | A button that appends UTM parameters to its link correctly, whatever the URL already contains. |
| [Unsubscribe](email/unsubscribe.md) | content | default, left | An unsubscribe link using Klaviyo's unsubscribe_link tag. |
| [View in Browser](email/view-in-browser.md) | section | default, page | A small "View it in your browser" line using Klaviyo's web view link. |
